## Roster and integration triage — 2026-11-16

Two read-only audits checked the character/enemy roster and Home Workshop decorations after Iteration 2179. Current top-level folder counts are **39 characters, 68 enemies, and 47 workshop-decoration folders** (folder counts include concept and review candidates, not production-ready content). The Leaf Lands already have Sproutlet and the Pulpal boss candidate; Mountain Lands now has Knotley plus Pomperstein. ## Iteration 1654 — raise Arrival completion before deactivating Rattle

`ScrapStormSentinel.DefeatRoutine` deactivated its own GameObject immediately before calling `GameEvents.RaiseLevelCompleted()`. ## Discovered / parking lot
- Toast SFX is centralized in `GameplayFeedback.Toast` — don't also call `PlayToastBlip` at call sites.
- Batchmode/hitch frames with large `deltaTime` crush jump apex — motor clamps dt to 1/30; smoke sets `maximumDeltaTime`.
- GulchFar and TerraceFloor previously overlapped in Z (~60–64), so landing samples hit terrace early — keep terrace start past gulch far extent.
- Batchmode: CollectibleDefinition refs loaded before `OpenScene` can go fake-null — reload after OpenScene before wiring pickups.

- Headless Unity needs an activated Hub license; works after Hub add/sign-in.
- Never use namespace `SpaceAndCrafts.Camera` — conflicts with `UnityEngine.Camera` via parent-namespace lookup.
- PlayerPlayground graybox primitives are TEMP ART only; must not migrate into finished Arrival art.
- First visual impression matters even in playgrounds — default gray Unity look reads as “lame”; keep TEMP but on-brand.
- `SaveAsPrefabAsset` / incomplete wiring previously left motor settings null — always verify SO refs after bootstrap.
- PrefabInstance property overrides can null out SO refs; unpack completely before wiring scene instances.
- Batchmode `SerializedObject` assignment to `CameraSettings` on new camera rigs has been flaky — verify scene YAML after bootstrap.
- Feel polish notes (baseline): MaxSpeed 7.75, Accel 62, Decel 96, AirControl 0.84, JumpHeight 2.52, Gravity -46, JumpCut 2.35x, Coyote 0.18, Buffer 0.18, Turn 980°/s, Cam Distance 8 / Height 2.28 / follow 0.1, Orbit 128, GamepadLook×1.25.
- Meshy showcase Boing at FBX×100 + SphereCollider.radius 0.9 ⇒ ~180–200m OnTriggerStay launch storm (smoke96 jump gain≈18). Showcase Boing must stay visual-only; `BoingOMatic` disables world radius >8m; sanitize menu rescales showcase triggers.
- Boss weak points only count while airborne (forces Boing-O-Matic exam).

## Iteration 1386 — verify the remesh is one joined shell before further weight edits (2026-10-31)

Extended the read-only UV report with an edge-connected-component audit. The 155,534-vertex remesh has **10** connected components, but the largest contains **155,525 vertices** (99.994% of the mesh). It includes essentially all off-white body and violet appendage vertices. Paint regions therefore do not correspond to separate mesh pieces that can safely be assigned wholesale to different bones; a hard white-to-Hips / violet-to-limb split would create abrupt skinning transitions across the same continuous surface. This supports a boundary-aware weight transition as a future approach, but does not prove a specific deformation fix.

## Iteration 1688 — align Splat's actual foot surface on tilted pads

The repeated Iter1687 frame showed a visible idle sole gap despite the old contact log reporting the renderer AABB minimum at support height. The rigid-foot solver was probing at each renderer's center but correcting its lowest world-AABB Y; on a tilted support, the AABB's lowest edge and the renderer center occupy different support heights. ## Iteration 1752 — restore the built invention on Continue (2026-11-03)

A parallel progression audit found a save/resume inconsistency in the Arrival craft loop: Continue restored `PlayerProgressSave.unlockedInventionIds` into `LevelSession` and the objective coach, but `BuildSite` kept its `_builtInventionIds` empty and the saved `ART_BoingOMatic` scene root was inactive. The quest could therefore advance to using an invention that remained hidden, while BuildSite still considered the base recipe unbuilt. Added Continue-only recipe hydration in `BuildSite.Awake`: it matches persisted IDs to this site's configured recipes, restores the most recently saved matching recipe flavor, activates the assembled root, and recomputes interaction availability. `IsBuilt` now applies the existing `InventionCompatibility` rule, so saved Turbo Boing also fulfills the base recipe and cannot be rebuilt as a duplicate. ## Iteration 1765 — fix compounded volume attenuation in fallback character voice (2026-11-03)

Source review found `MakeFormantChirp` baked each requested bark volume into its generated samples, then `PlayBark` applied the same value again with `AudioSource.PlayOneShot`; the component's `AudioSource` volume was also applied. Thus generated fallback voices used an unintended volume-squared multiplier before source gain (for example, a 0.22 effort bark received only 0.0484 of the clip's normalized level), while baked voice clips used their one-shot value once. Fallback waveforms now use a bounded normalized envelope (`0.72 × sin` fade); `PlayOneShot` remains the only per-event level control. Baked clips are unchanged. This should restore intended relative emphasis of movement/effort voice cues, but it has not been auditioned, mixed against effects/music, or measured in a gameplay capture; no build, test, or human play was performed.
